kse-alert@.service: /bin/sh -c 'journalctl --user -u "$$0" -n 40 -o cat --no-pager | /usr/bin/docker run --rm -i --name kse-alert-notify --user %U:%G -e HOME=/tmp -e UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/uv-cache --memory=256m --memory-swap=256m --cpus=0.5 --env-file %h/quant-secrets/k-stock-engine.env --env-file %h/quant-secrets/kse-alert.env -v %h/k-stock-engine/data:/app/data -v %h/k-stock-engine/logs:/app/logs ghcr.io/kthyeong/k-stock-engine:latest uv run python -m src.ops.jobs alert --unit "$$0" --result "$$(systemctl --user show -p Result --value "$$0")" --exit-status "$$(systemctl --user show -p ExecMainStatus --value "$$0")"' %i
kse-auction-open.service: /usr/bin/docker run --rm --log-opt max-size=10m --log-opt max-file=3 --name kse-auction-open --user %U:%G -e HOME=/tmp -e UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/uv-cache --memory=512m --memory-swap=512m --cpus=0.5 --env-file %h/quant-secrets/k-stock-engine.env --env-file %h/quant-secrets/kis-data.env -v %h/.cache/kis:/app/.cache/kis -e KIS_TOKEN_CACHE_DIR=/app/.cache/kis -e BROKER_ADMISSION_CLASS=standard -v %h/k-stock-engine/data:/app/data -v %h/k-stock-engine/logs:/app/logs ghcr.io/kthyeong/k-stock-engine:latest uv run python -m src.execution auction-open --decisions-dir /app/data/state/kr_swing_2019_v1/decisions --shadow-dir /app/data/state/kr_swing_2019_v1/shadow --out /app/data/ops/auction/open.json --events-root /app/data/ops/events --limit 80
